name: ad_admin_members
description: AD 管理员组成员 (Domain Admins + Enterprise Admins). One row per (domain_dn, group_name, member_sam), upserted centre-side via MERGE. Cadence 24h (admin group membership changes are infrequent). Data lands in public ad_admin_members table via a centre-side post-hook (see center/src/packages/runner.js); this manifest has NO `database` block by design (R110.A architectural pivot: 公共表, not pkg_* schema).  Single-DC semantic implemented via centre-side MERGE dedup on (domain_dn, group_name, member_sam) — every DC runs collect.ps1, the centre collapses duplicate rows.
